data.name: Alyan
data.gender_notes: Alyan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'alya', meaning 'to be high, to rise, to exalt'. In Islamic context, it signifies the Light of Allah that guides and illuminates. The name Alyan carries the meaning “Light of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alyan usually hope their child will grow to embody light of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Alyan is a name that connects us to the night sky and the beauty of nature. It is a reminder of the wonders of the universe and the mystery of the divine.
data.etymology: Alyan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alyan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
